correctness.rationale: For m>=3 two vertices within a clique column have a common third neighbor; selected words have at most one nonzero symbol per column. Direct analysis of length-two walks gives necessary and sufficient conditions: nonzero adjacent letters equal, nonzero distance-two letters unequal. The weighted four-state transition matrix therefore bijectively counts all open packings, with x by selected vertex and y by induced selected edge. Its exact rational inverse yields the formula. For each n mod 3 all occupancy maximizers are classified by runs of lengths one or two; row labels are counted with correct gap constraints including q=0 and q=1 boundaries. Direct graph-subset enumeration agrees on all 16 tested small graphs; formal recurrence and exact maxima agree in 162 cases. The infinite proof is not inferred from computation.

value.rationale: The proposed invariant counts every open packing by both cardinality and number of selected adjacency edges in a canonical two-parameter graph family, strictly refining the already-known extremal cardinality. The four-state transfer has closed rational coefficients and the maximum cases exhibit a complete residue-dependent structural classification, giving exact solution multiplicities that the scalar 2020 product theorem does not supply. The induced edge statistic is natural because every open packing induces a matching. These are complete natural counting invariants, not a narrow artificial slice or trivial change of variables.
